name: R067-gengar-truant-skill-swap-focus-punch
why: Challenge 7. The opponent's lead Slaking (659: Truant, Choice Band, Earthquake...) cannot hurt the player's Gengar (613, Levitate). Gengar uses Skill Swap on turn 1 and so has Truant; Slaking's Choice Band locks it into its first move. Gengar kills Slaking with Psychic; the AI's replacement Machamp (810: Focus Punch, Substitute, Attract, Double Team) is then Skill Swapped as well (Gengar passes Truant on) and on a loafing turn the AI may choose Focus Punch, which makes the Focus Punch set-up pre-pass skip it (runFocusPunchSetUpPrePass). The step needs Gengar's Skill Swap twice and the AI picking Focus Punch on the loafing turn, so most seeds miss.
